tagline: A coloured blob in an open arena. Swallow the smaller ones. Send the link and the others are people.
description:
You are a little round blob in a wide arena. Drift around, swallow the dots, grow. Bigger blobs swallow smaller ones — including you, if you get careless. That is the whole game.

Send the invite and everyone who opens the link lands in the same arena. There is no game server, no account and no lobby. The room is the link, and it holds together in the browsers of the people playing. Playing alone, a few wandering blobs keep you company; they scatter the moment a second person arrives.

On a computer, WASD or the arrows steer, or just point the mouse. On a phone, a thumb on the stick is enough.

An unofficial port of example-.io-game by vzhou842, MIT-licensed. The original needs a game server. This copy does not: the meeting is the room.
